name: splunk_update_dashboard
title: Dashboard Update Capability
description: Updates an existing dashboard in the custom_app app by replacing its whole source. eai_data must be the complete new dashboard (Simple XML version="1.1" or Dashboard Studio version="2" with a <definition> CDATA block), never just the changed part: anything left out is removed. Read the current source first with splunk_run_query: | rest /servicesNS/nobody/custom_app/data/ui/views/<dashboard_name> splunk_server=local | fields eai:data. Only reaches dashboards shared with the app, not private ones.

dashboard_name.description: ID of an existing dashboard in custom_app (the name in its URL, not its label)

eai_data.description: Complete new dashboard source, starting with <dashboard> and containing a <label> element. Replaces the current source entirely.

examples.name: Update an existing dashboard

arguments.eai_data: <dashboard version="1.1"><label>Error Overview</label><row><panel><chart><search><query>index=main error | timechart span=1h count by host</query><earliest>-7d</earliest><latest>now</latest></search></chart></panel></row></dashboard>

examples.expected_use: When a user asks to change, fix or extend an existing dashboard in custom_app
